summary: Website for uploading items to buy and sell with basic security features.
architectural_notes: Requires user authentication/authorization to secure item uploads and buy/sell actions.

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity authentication in the UI and require users to be signed in before they can create listings, edit/delete their own listings, or purchase an item.
Build the core marketplace UI: a browse page showing all listings with search/filter and an item detail view showing title, description, price, seller, status, and images.
Add a “Create Listing” flow in the UI that allows an authenticated user to add a new item with title, description, price, and images, and persists it to the backend.
Add “My Listings” management UI for authenticated users to view, edit, and delete their own listings, with backend enforcement of ownership.
Add a purchase flow in the UI for authenticated users to buy an Available listing; on success, mark it Sold and display the buyer/sold state in the UI.

Establish a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, layout, and components) suitable for a marketplace and apply it consistently across pages and states (empty/loading/error). Avoid a blue/purple primary palette.
Generate and include custom static images used by the UI (logo and a simple hero/banner illustration) and render them from frontend static assets (not via the backend).

Update the website’s user-facing branding name to “Meyouu” wherever the app name is displayed (including the browser tab title, header logo alt text, footer copyright line, and homepage hero/banner alt text and headline).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a buy/sell marketplace website where users can upload items for sale and purchase items, with basic security (e.g., authentication and protected actions).

Create backend data models and canister methods to support marketplace listings: create listing, list all listings, get listing by id, update listing, delete listing, and purchase (mark as sold and record buyer).

Enforce basic security/authorization rules in the backend using the caller Principal: only the seller can update or delete their own listings; only authenticated callers can create listings or purchase; purchasing is only allowed when the listing is Available; prevent a seller from purchasing their own item.
